hookups.source: Campspot site catalog for park 4510: every RV site has Water Hook-Up; 50-Amp on the deluxe and some standard sites; Sewer Hook-Up on the 20 '30/50 AMP DELUXE FULL HOOKUP RV SITE' sites L01-L20; read 2026-11-15

sites.source: Campspot site catalog for park 4510: 49 pull-through sites (DELUXE PULL THROUGH 30/50AMP 17, STANDARD PULL THROUGH 30AMP 32); longest listed rig 77 ft (sites 042/044); read 2026-11-15

note: City of Colona campground off I-80/I-74 east of the Quad Cities, with a pool, mini golf and a fishing pond. The pond sites ring the horseshoe pond: 130-144 around its outer bank and 112-120 on the peninsula (121-129 there are tent sites). The city also rents sites for the whole season. --Claude
summary: Campspot engine read (park 4510): 149 RV sites, 17 tent, 6 cabins, all nightly; platform campspot + url confirmed, water at every RV site, sewer on L01-L20, 50A, 49 pull-throughs, rigs to 77 ft; fees ($60-70 + $5/3% park fee) and season 05-01..10-31 match stored; pond kept on named sites; nightly vs seasonal occupancy not measurable off season.
flags: WATERFRONT pond KEPT: the ~1.3 ha (under 5 acres) horseshoe pond; Campspot sells by the night 'DELUXE WATERFRONT 30AMP/50AMP BACK IN/PULL IN SITE' 130-144 (outer east/south bank, ~41.4640,-90.3220) and 'STANDARD WATERFRONT 30AMP SITE' 112-120 (peninsula, ~41.4640,-90.3231), RV pads 5-20 m from the water over open mown grass on Esri imagery. 104/106/109-111 are also typed waterfront but sit across the park road north of the pond: not counted.
SITE COUNT: stored count 195 (derived, from the inclusion text '~195') vs the Campspot catalog's 149 RV + 17 tent sites; seasonal-lease sites may not be on the engine, so count left as stored.

LONG-STAY: city sells seasonal leases (2026 Rules PDF v1.7 is mostly an 'RV Seasonal Site Contract'; seasonal $2,625-3,150) and weekly/monthly 'pending availability', but no wording discouraging nightly guests; the engine sells every site nightly. Off season (RESORT_CLOSED_RULE on 2026-11-18; 2027 dates not yet open), so the share of sites actually held by seasonals could not be measured. Local (city) campground: no price gate; base $60 a night.

Phone 309-714-5514 matches the city page. Websites kept (stored second link https://www.campspot.com/park/colonascott was not re-fetched); the city page's own Book link is https://www.campspot.com/book/colonascott-fp, now in booking.url.
